signs.title: Know the Signs, Take Action, Save Lives
signs.description: Early detection changes everything — here's what that looks like in practice.

knowSigns.title: Know the Signs
knowSigns.description: Persistent lumps, unusual bleeding, unexplained weight loss, or changes that don't go away — recognizing early warning signs is the first step toward beating cancer.

takeAction.title: Take Action
takeAction.description: We make it easy to act on those signs — free screening, referrals, and support to get a diagnosis without delay or financial fear.

saveLives.title: Save Lives
saveLives.description: Early detection dramatically improves survival. Every person screened in time is a life this campaign has helped save.

reach.title: Reach
reach.description: We go house-to-house across wards and villages.

screenEducate.title: Screen & Educate
screenEducate.description: Free on-site screening and health education.

supportTreat.title: Support & Treat
supportTreat.description: Covering surgery, medication, and care costs.

followUp.title: Follow Up
followUp.description: Ongoing support until the patient is stable.

screening.title: Cancer Screening & Awareness
screening.description: Free community screening, symposiums, and early-detection education.

surgery.title: Surgery & Medical Support
surgery.description: Covering the cost of surgery and treatment for patients who can't afford care.

remoteVillages.title: Support for Cancer Patients in Remote Villages
remoteVillages.description: Reaching cancer patients in remote and underserved villages with screening, treatment support, and follow-up care they can't otherwise access.

healthWorkerTraining.title: Collaborative Health Worker Training
healthWorkerTraining.description: Partnering with local health workers in remote and underserved communities to build lasting, hands-on cancer-care skills.

qualityOfLife.title: Improving Quality of Life & Health Safety
qualityOfLife.description: Working to raise everyday health standards and safety for underserved communities, beyond one-time interventions.

story.title: Healing Beyond the Hospital Walls
story.description: What started as a single cancer awareness walk in Bende LGA has grown into a grassroots movement — partnering with local government, medical associations, and community leaders to make sure care reaches people, not the other way around.

grassroots.title: Reaching Grassroots in West Africa
grassroots.description: From village health posts to remote community halls, we're taking the message and the means of early cancer detection beyond the cities — to the underserved corners of West Africa where it's needed most.

about.title: A grassroots foundation built on showing up
about.intro: The Macedonian Call Cancer Foundation started with a single cancer awareness walk in Bende LGA. Since then, it's grown into an ongoing partnership with local government, medical associations, and community leaders — working to make sure cancer screening, treatment, and support actually reach the people who need them.
about.mission: Taking the news and message of cancer to the grassroots and underserved communities in Africa.
about.vision: Achieving a cancer-free world irrespective of social status and location.

community.title: Community First
community.description: We go where people are, instead of waiting for them to find us.

dignity.title: Dignity in Care
dignity.description: Every patient we support is treated with respect, not charity as pity.

followThrough.title: Follow Through
followThrough.description: We don't stop at a single visit — support continues until the patient is stable.
